vignette: A resident reviews the charts of two children with hemophilia. One child has a much greater degree of clotting factor deficiency than the other.
stem: Which expectation about oral bleeding in these two children is most consistent with current guidance?

options.text: The child with the greater deficiency would generally be expected to have more severe bleeding manifestations.
Both children would be expected to bleed equally severely regardless of factor level.
The child with the greater deficiency would generally be expected to have milder bleeding.
Bleeding severity depends only on oral hygiene and not on the degree of factor deficiency.
